title: Updating the scratch product
statement: For any register state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $14$ of its register-value vector by $z$ yields the register-value vector of the state obtained by replacing its scratch product by $z$.
replaced:
Let $σ$ be a record of fifteen natural-number registers, and let $R(σ)$ list its
registers in order, with the scratch product at coordinate $14$. Replacing coordinate
$14$ of $R(σ)$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the record obtained from $σ$ by
replacing its scratch product by $z$.
